set.name: Polynomials and integral algebraic expressions

criteria: Derive all coefficient equations, including zero coefficients that restrict factor structure.
Solve every compatible case and check the resulting product and coefficient domain.
set.description: Determine possible polynomial factors or parameters by fixing degree-compatible factor forms, expanding and equating coefficients. Enforce coefficient-domain restrictions and verify that the cases are exhaustive.
set.name: Factorization by matching coefficients
set.nameZh: 比较系数确定因式分解

set.name: Multiplying Polynomials

set.description: 同类项的系数相加，字母和字母的指数不变。
set.name: Combining Like Terms

set.description: 把含未知数的项移到一边、常数项移到另一边（移项要变号），再合并同类项、系数化为 1。
set.name: Solving Equations by Transposing Terms and Combining Like Terms
set.nameZh: 移项与合并同类项解方程

criteria: Constrain a general remainder of the required degree.
set.description: Use P=DQ+R with degree R less than degree D; division by x-a leaves P(a), and x-a is a factor exactly when P(a)=0.
set.name: Polynomial division, remainders, and factors
set.nameZh: 多项式除法、余式与因式定理

set.description: 去括号并合并同类项，完成整式的加减运算。
set.name: Addition and Subtraction of Polynomials

set.reason: Simplifying polynomial sums/differences requires collecting the resulting like terms.
After transposition, reducing ax-cx and the constant terms is a like-term combination.
The target distinguishes factoring from polynomial expansion and relates them as reverse operations, so the expansion/product direction is part of this comparison.
set.scope: Relating factorization to multiplication as inverses

set.reason: The chosen procedure compares the expanded factor product to the supplied polynomial. The named procedure explicitly expands an assumed degree-compatible factor product and matches its monomial coefficients. Those two components are necessary within this procedure; a standard special-form factoring sequence is only preparation.

The defining condition that deg R is less than deg D, and the act of dividing polynomials, both presuppose knowing polynomial terms, coefficients and degree. No alternative route avoids these notions.
set.scope: polynomial degree and terms in P=DQ+R

set.description: 把一个多项式化为几个整式的积叫因式分解，它与整式乘法互为逆运算。
